questions.q: Why did Esau embrace Jacob rather than attack him?
choices: When a man's ways please the Lord, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him
Jacob paid him the birthright back
questions.explain: The embrace is not proof the hatred was gone; the Most High put that peace on Esau in that moment (Proverbs 16:7).

questions.q: Why did Jacob decline to travel with Esau?
choices: He wanted to go to Egypt
He stayed wise and kept his distance, pleading the tender children and flocks
questions.explain: Esau returned that day to Seir.

questions.q: What did Jacob call the altar he erected at Shalem?
choices: Elelohe-Israel: God, the God of Israel
questions.explain: He bought a parcel of a field for an hundred pieces of money.
